title: Slay the Demon King
summary: Gather the five holy relics and face the Demon King.
description: The Demon King can only be defeated with the five holy relics. Travel through an ancient temple, a snowy mountain, a burning village, a forge and a rope bridge, and choose the proverb that gives Bird the Sage's wisest advice. Your choices decide which relics you win, what it costs you, and how the story ends.
